headline: XRP Ledger implements fix for token burning vulnerability
summary: The XRP Ledger has deployed a software update to resolve a bug that allowed authorized token burners to improperly create new tokens. Validators activated the fix on Wednesday, following a reset of the activation clock in October.
why: The XRP Ledger is an open-source, decentralized blockchain network. Security patches are critical for maintaining the integrity of distributed ledgers and preventing unauthorized token issuance.

impacts.name: XRP
impacts.why: The fix addresses a technical vulnerability in the ledger's token burning mechanism.
